userStories.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: WARNING [src/supervisor/host.ts:119]: makeReadReviewReport validates only JSON-parseability and object-ness, not the ReviewReport shape. A valid-JSON-but-wrong-shape review-report.json (e.g. one missing the `verdict` field, or a top-level array) is returned as a bogus ReviewReport, so makeReviewDispatch (review.ts:418-428) runs `/^FIXES_PENDING:(\d+)$/.exec(undefined)`, derives FIXES_PENDING:0, and creates a contentless placeholder fix story, even overriding a valid <review>CLEAN</review> tag in the pane. This contradicts US-004 AC2, which requires that a report 'present but malformed (invalid JSON or wrong shape)' falls back to the <review>-tag verdict. The US-004 tests only simulate malformed via an injected reader returning null (review.test.ts:817,844), so the wrong-shape-object path through the real production reader is uncovered. Fix: add a verdict-shape guard to makeReadReviewReport (return null when `verdict` is not a string) and add a regression test feeding a wrong-shape object through the real reader / dispatch asserting tag fallback.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: CRITICAL [src/supervisor/review.ts:363]: review-report.json is never cleared before a review dispatch, unlike worker-report.json which is erased at loop.ts:658 specifically 'to prevent a leftover report file from triggering a false-positive on the first poll tick'. makeReviewDispatch respawns the reviewer then, after a single sleepFn(pollIntervalMs), immediately reads readReviewReport() before the pane-death check. On review round 2+ within one cam run (and across cam run sessions, since the file is gitignored but persists in the working tree) the stale round-1 report is read and breaks the poll loop with the previous round's verdict/findings, ignoring the still-booting round-2 reviewer. The result is a false-positive completion that replays stale findings until MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT. Mirror the worker-report fix: add a makeClearReviewReport(cwd) factory in host.ts and a clearReviewReport seam invoked before the respawn-pane in makeReviewDispatch.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: WARNING [docs/recovery-runbook.md:757]: Section (m) documents a ReviewReport shape that does not match the code or the agent spec. (1) Severity values are shown as 'error'/'warn' (lines 759-760, 768) but the agent instruction, the ReviewReport type, and the tests use CRITICAL/WARNING/SUGGESTION. (2) The verdict example is 'FIXES_PENDING' without ':N' and lists MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT as a possible file verdict (lines 757, 767), but review.ts:407 requires 'FIXES_PENDING:N' to extract the count and the reviewer never writes MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT (it is derived by the supervisor); a reviewer following this example would have its findings count parsed as 0. (3) Lines 20 and 745 claim the sidecar 'deletes the file', which no code does (see the CRITICAL). Reconcile the runbook with the real schema and clearing behavior.

findings.text: makeReadReviewReport validates only JSON-parseability and object-ness, not the ReviewReport shape. A valid-JSON-but-wrong-shape review-report.json (e.g. one missing the `verdict` field, or a top-level array) is returned as a bogus ReviewReport, so makeReviewDispatch (review.ts:418-428) runs `/^FIXES_PENDING:(\d+)$/.exec(undefined)`, derives FIXES_PENDING:0, and creates a contentless placeholder fix story, even overriding a valid <review>CLEAN</review> tag in the pane. This contradicts US-004 AC2, which requires that a report 'present but malformed (invalid JSON or wrong shape)' falls back to the <review>-tag verdict. The US-004 tests only simulate malformed via an injected reader returning null (review.test.ts:817,844), so the wrong-shape-object path through the real production reader is uncovered. Fix: add a verdict-shape guard to makeReadReviewReport (return null when `verdict` is not a string) and add a regression test feeding a wrong-shape object through the real reader / dispatch asserting tag fallback.

prd.review.findings is never reset when a round produces no file-based findings. The CLEAN write (:465-474), the MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT write (:484-491), and the tag-fallback FIXES_PENDING write (fileFindings undefined) all spread `...(prd.review ?? {})` without clearing findings, so stale findings from a prior FIXES_PENDING round persist into a later CLEAN/debt review state. Informational only (findings is not a decision gate in decide.ts), but the durable record can misrepresent the latest round.

buildFixStories iterates by the verdict's N count (Math.max(count, 1)) rather than findings.length. If the reviewer's verdict N (CRITICAL + actionable WARNINGs) diverges from the findings array length (which may also include SUGGESTIONs), trailing findings are silently dropped or extra noteless stories are created. Consider keying the story count to findings.length when file findings are present.
